decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with +1/+1 counters and beefing them up with the Hardened Scales enchantment. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Arcbound Ravager, Walking Ballista, and Hangarback Walker while constantly adding counters with Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp and The Ozolith. The deck also includes artifacts like Welding Jar and Urza's Saga to provide additional support and utility. Overall, the key concept is to rapidly grow and buff up your creatures to quickly close out the game with a strong aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with small creatures and using Hardened Scales to pump them up, while also utilizing cards like Arcbound Ravager and Walking Ballista to increase their power even further. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, while utilizing cards like The Ozolith and Welding Jar to protect your key creatures. Lurrus of the Dream-Den serves as a companion to provide additional value and recursion. The deck also includes versatile lands like Urza's Saga to further boost your board presence.

The core concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent through efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan with instant speed removal and counter spells like Lightning Bolt, Unholy Heat, Spell Pierce, Archmage's Charm, and Counterspell. The deck aims to control the game tempo by efficiently deploying threats and answers, while utilizing card draw and manipulation effects like Expressive Iteration and Consider to maintain card advantage and find key pieces to close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch. The deck also aims to generate card advantage and filter through the library with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. By using Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck can further enhance its aggressiveness and resilience by constantly recurring key threats or disruption spells from the graveyard.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive spirit creatures that benefit from each other's presence on the battlefield. By utilizing cards like Drogskol Captain and Supreme Phantom to pump up the spirits, along with disruptive creatures like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly. With a mix of flash creatures and powerful removal spells like Prismatic Ending, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure with its evasive creatures. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility for the deck.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressively dealing damage to the opponent with a mix of artifact synergy and efficient creatures. The deck utilizes cards like Experimental Synthesizer and Mishra's Bauble to draw cards and keep up the pressure, while also taking advantage of the sacrifice synergies with Disciple of the Vault. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional recursion and value over the course of the game. With a mix of artifact manipulation and evasive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and close out the game.

This deck focuses on combining cards like Indomitable Creativity, Wrenn and Six, and Archon of Cruelty to create powerful board states that are difficult for opponents to handle. By utilizing a variety of planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler, along with efficient removal spells and card draw, the deck aims to control the game while setting up for game-winning combo plays. The mana base includes a mix of fetch lands and triomes to ensure consistency in casting spells and activating abilities across different colors.

This deck focuses on assembling the Heliod combo quickly by using cards like Conclave Mentor and Spike Feeder to gain infinite life and power up creatures, allowing for a quick win condition. The deck also includes cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Ranger-Captain of Eos for additional creature support and disruption. The mana base is designed for consistency and speed, with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Collected Company helping to ramp and find key combo pieces. Overall, the deck is built around maximizing the efficiency of the Heliod Life combo for a strong and competitive Modern format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with dredge cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, which can then be used to bring back powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Narcomoeba. Combining this with cards like Cathartic Reunion and Creeping Chill allows for fast graveyard recursion and can overwhelm opponents with a swarm of creatures. The addition of Silversmote Ghoul and Ox of Agonas provide additional options for graveyard interactions and card draw, making this deck a strong combo archetype in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly reducing your own life total to beef up the power of Death's Shadow, while using disruptive spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to control your opponent's hand. Utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to put pressure on your opponent, while also utilizing Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion to provide additional value from the graveyard. The deck aims to be fast, aggressive, and disruptive to overwhelm your opponent and secure a quick victory.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful equipment combo, utilizing cards like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to cheat equipment into play and attach them for free. The key strategy involves using Colossus Hammer to give a creature massive power and evasion, allowing for quick and devastating attacks. The deck also includes cards like The Reality Chip and Sigarda's Aid to support the equipment theme, while utilizing cards like Spell Pierce for protection. By efficiently assembling the combo pieces, this deck can overwhelm opponents with powerful, hard-to-stop attacks.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combination of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to create a powerful attacking threat. By using Stoneforge Mystic to search for equipment and Steelshaper's Gift to find key pieces, the deck aims to equip creatures for lethal damage as early as possible. The inclusion of various 0-cost artifacts like Ornithopter and Memnite allows for explosive starts, while Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional recursion. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to search for key pieces and generate extra value.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly reduce your own life total in order to power up Death's Shadow, while utilizing a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. Lurrus of the Dream-Den acts as a companion to help recur key cards from the graveyard. The deck aims to be fast, efficient, and adaptable, using a combination of card advantage, removal, and synergy between its cards to overwhelm the opponent.

The main objective of this deck is to establish UrzaTron (consisting of Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. Once UrzaTron is assembled, the deck aims to play powerful threats such as Karn Liberated, Karn, the Great Creator, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the game and take over the board. The deck also includes versatile cards like Ancient Stirrings and Expedition Map to help find key pieces of the Tron lands and threats. It focuses on controlling the opponent's board and resources while establishing a dominant position on the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to fill the graveyard with Dredge cards like Golgari Thug and Stinkweed Imp to bring powerful creatures like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam onto the battlefield. By using cards like Cathartic Reunion and Thrilling Discovery to discard cards and draw more options, the deck aims to quickly set up a powerful board presence. Additionally, utilizing cards like Ox of Agonas and Silversmote Ghoul, the deck can generate card advantage and keep the engine running. Overall, the key strategy revolves around leveraging the graveyard mechanic to accelerate the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to combo off and overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling, the deck can tutor for key creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to create powerful board states and generate value. The deck also includes resilient creatures like Young Wolf and Strangleroot Geist to ensure consistency in setting up the combo. With a mix of ramp, disruption, and recursion, this deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent in the Modern format.
